services.name: Horse Boarding
services.desc: Welcome to our premier horse boarding facility, where the care and comfort of your equine companions are our top priority. We understand the unique needs of horses and provide a serene and well-maintained environment for them to thrive. Our comprehensive boarding services are designed to meet the highest standards of care, ensuring that your horse is healthy, happy, and well-attended to at all times. Explore our range of services below to discover how we can offer your horse a home away from home. Premier Hunter/Jumper Facility offering top-tier instruction for safety and success in the arena. Sign up for our newsletter now to stay in the loop with all our exciting updates and

variants.label: Full horse boarding with daily care and feeding

includes: AM and PM feeding routine with hay twice daily
Access to grass pastures and river sand areas for turnout
One fan per stall, regular cleaning and fresh shavings as needed
Stalls cleaned daily and watering areas refreshed daily
Nightly checks by staff and onsite professional groom available
Daily administration of supplements and prompt communication for replenishment
blurb: Sommerview Farm offers private and small group horseback riding lessons for all skill levels, focusing on building confidence and refining technique. The farm also provides comprehensive horse boarding services with daily feeding, turnout, stall maintenance, and professional grooming. The facility includes 28 stalls, 5 pastures, two outdoor arenas, and a full-service caretaker on site.
